title: The Wildflower Waiting in the Soil
short_teaser: Seed banks can remain underground for years until disturbance or weather creates the right conditions.
story: Seed banks can remain underground for years until disturbance or weather creates the right conditions. Potential may survive quietly through an unsuitable season. Nature and place reveal timing, interdependence, adaptation, patience, and the value of looking closely. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Potential may survive quietly through an unsuitable season. Nature and place reveal timing, interdependence, adaptation, patience, and the value of looking closely.
spark_application: Notice one natural pattern or place today and write what it suggests about your own pace. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
